crossRefs.note: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.
Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.
For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life…
There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your…
I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you…
Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.” ’

translations.web: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
translations.bsb: The crown of the wise is their wealth, but the effort of fools is folly.
translations.kjv: The crown of the wise is their riches: but the foolishness of fools is folly.
translations.asv: The crown of the wise is their riches; But the folly of fools is only folly.
